questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The department conferred a scholarship to Kailash.

options.text: A scholarship had been conferred to Kailash by the department.
A scholarship is being conferred to Kailash by the department.
A scholarship was conferred to Kailash by the department.
A scholarship has been conferred in Kailash by the department.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**A scholarship was conferred to Kailash by the department**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As we can see the given sentence is in the active voice format of the **simple past tense** as the** past participle (conferred)** is applied in the sentence, so we have to **change** the** active** voice as per the **same tense rules**.
 
• **Active voice**: Subject +** V2** + object
 
• **Passive voice**: Object + **was/were + V3** + by + subject
 
• Example:
 
 
• Active voice: *Maya **cleaned** the dishes.*
 
• Passive voice: *The dishes** were cleaned by** Maya.*
 
 
 
• By following the above-mentioned rules, we have to change the **active to passive **by applying the** third form of the verb (conferred)** and **past helping verb (was) **in the **sentence.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: *A scholarship was conferred to Kailash by the department.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us take a look at the rules of simple past active passive voice:

 
• **Active** voice: Subject +** V2** + object
 
• **Passive** voice: Object + **was/were + V3 + by** + subject
 
• **Active** voice: Subject + **did + not + v1 **+ object
 
• **Passive** voice: Object +** was/were + not + V3 + by** Subject
 
• **Active** voice:** Did +** subject + **V1 **+ object +?
 
• **Passive** voice:** Was/were** + Object +** V3 + by** subject +?

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Biden __write a letter__ to the Russian President to restrain from war.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**wrote a ****letter'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment is **'**wrote a letter'.
 
• The incident in the given sentence took place in the past, and the underlined segment was in **present tense**, so in order to form a meaningful sentence we have to change it in the **past tense**. 
 
• The** past tense verb** is appropriate given the context of the sentence, which suggests that the action of writing the letter has **already taken place**. 
 
• 
 
We don't typically use the present tense to talk about a specific action that happened at a specific time.

 
 
• 
 
In English, the past tense is used to talk about:

 
 
• Completed actions in the past.
 
• Past habits or situations that no longer exist.
 
• Past facts or generalizations.
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

**Correct Sentence:**__* **Biden __wrote a letter__ to the Russian President to restrain from war.*

questions.question: **Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition. **

options.text: We have been playing for 4 o’clock.
We have been playing from 4 o’clock.
We have been playing to 4 o’clock.
We have been playing since 4 o’clock.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **We have been playing since 4 o’clock. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in which there is an appropriate use of preposition is "We have been playing since 4 o’clock. "
 
• The preposition **'****since' **means** from a time in the past until the time under consideration, typically the present.**
 
 
• Example - I've felt better **since **I've been here.
 
 
 
• The sentence implies that they had been playing from a time in the past i.e. 4 o' clock until the time under consideration, typically the present.
 
• Therefore, **option 4 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss preposition:
 
• **Preposition - **A word used to show position of objects or places or human.
 
• **For **is used for stating purpose of object or action.
 
• **From **is used to show where someone or something starts.
 
• **To **is used to indicate a destination or direction.
